expected.finding: **[P2]** File references with punctuation or line ranges bypass filtering ([line 269](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:269)). Both `` `scripts/worker.py`. `` and `scripts/worker.py:41-43` produce `scripts` and `worker` tokens. Two unrelated findings referencing the punctuated filename consequently mine a `scripts-worker` topic. Normalize surrounding punctuation and line ranges before checking extensions.

**[P2]** Counting slashes discards legitimate problem descriptions ([line 272](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:272)). `deadlock/livelock/starvation` is treated as a location and removed entirely. Two findings containing that phrase plus an absolute file path yield no tokens or topics, preventing discovery of the recurring defect. Require stronger location evidence than slash count alone.

 # of problem it is: "/home/runner/work/<repo>/scripts/x.py:41" must not
 # hand mining the tokens home, runner, scripts or the repository's own name

-_LOCATION_RE = re.compile(
-    r"https?://\S+"  # URLs

-    r"|\S+\.(?:py|ts|tsx|js|mjs|yml|yaml|json|jsonl|md|sh|toml)\b(?::\d+)?"  # file references
+_LOCATION_EXTENSIONS = (
+    ".py",
+    ".ts",
+    ".tsx",
+    ".js",
+    ".mjs",
+    ".yml",
+    ".yaml",
+    ".json",

 )
+
+
+def is_location(word: str) -> bool:
+    """A URL, an absolute or explicitly relative path, a multi-segment path,
+    or a file reference (x.py, x.py:41). Checked per whitespace-separated
+    word with plain string tests, so a long string costs linear time
+    (Codex review of PR #56, round 2)."""
+    w = word.strip("()[]<>`'\",;")
+    if w.startswith(("http://", "https://", "/", "./", "../", "~/")):
+        return True
+    if w.count("/") >= 2:
+        return True
+    base = w.rsplit(":", 1)[0] if ":" in w and w.rsplit(":", 1)[1].isdigit() else w
+    return base.lower().endswith(_LOCATION_EXTENSIONS)
+
+
 # A token present in more than this share of ALL archived findings is the

 # a class of problem, and may not name or define a mined topic.

+def background_tokens(
